prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: sideswipe while changing lanes in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1143; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Photos confirm some details, but there are no independent witnesses.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was operating a sedan in the left lane of a multi-lane roadway in League City, Texas, when the vehicle made a lane change into the adjacent lane. Driver 2, traveling in that lane, was unable to avoid contact, and the two vehicles sideswiped one another along the passenger side of Driver 1's car and the driver side of Driver 2's car. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy under which the vehicle is registered. A Passenger was seated in the front right seat and was present at the scene. Officers and the statements gathered at the scene confirm that the Passenger was inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported back strain following the collision and stated pain began shortly afterward, though it is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash. Photographs taken at the scene confirm several details of the sequence, and the damage to both vehicles is consistent with the described impact. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to the reporting officer. No independent witnesses were identified, so the account relies on the statements of the drivers and the physical evidence recorded at the scene.
